tagline: One of the largest outdoor advertising companies in the United States, operating billboards, logo signs, and transit displays across 45 states and Canada
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of digital displays is the primary driver of growth and modernization in the outdoor advertising sector, representing a key transition toward more dynamic and premium formats enabling higher rates.

kpis.name: Digital billboard count
kpis.explanation: Total number of digital advertising displays operated by the company.
kpis.description: Digital displays enable rapid ad changes and higher rates.
kpis.signal: Park modernization and revenue growth potential.

kpis.name: Total billboard count
kpis.explanation: Total number of billboard displays (traditional and digital) owned and operated.
kpis.description: Includes bulletins, posters, and digital displays across 45 states and Canada.

kpis.name: Logo sign count
kpis.explanation: Number of advertising displays located near highway exits, primarily for local services.
kpis.description: Lamar is the largest logo sign provider in the United States with 24 state contracts.
kpis.signal: Leadership in a niche, regulated segment.

kpis.name: Transit display count
kpis.explanation: Number of displays on public transportation, shelters, benches, and airports.
kpis.description: Operated in over 80 markets across the United States and Canada.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual capital expenditures, notably for new displays and equipment.
kpis.description: Total capex reached 180.8 million in 2025 (180,800 k$), driven by digital billboards representing 90.9 million.

kpis.name: Annual acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Total cash amount paid for advertising asset acquisitions.
kpis.description: In 2025, acquisitions totaled 191.1 million, including Verde Outdoor valued at 147.6 million via unit issuance (1,500+ billboards across ten states).
kpis.signal: Active external growth in fragmented outdoor sector.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 6.93 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 4.92 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Digital billboard capex
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditure allocated to digital billboards.
kpis.description: Digital capex reached 90.9 million in 2025, representing over 72% of total billboard capex, up 49.8% versus 2024.
kpis.signal: Clear strategic priority on park digitalization.

risks.title: Cybersecurity breaches and legal exposure
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at beginning of Item 1A (strong position). Direct language: could suffer and significant legal and financial exposure indicates high intensity. Cybersecurity category = maximum weighting. Trend stable but dedicated team mentioned suggests risk recognized and managed.

risks.title: Real estate lease dependence and renegotiation
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in Item 2 (important position). Concrete figures: 71,500 leased sites for 348.1 million USD annually (17% of advertising revenue). Language important part of our management activity underscores criticality. Trend stable but high concentration risk on lease portfolio.

risks.title: Sensitivity to general economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated in Item 7 (MD&A). Language particularly sensitive to changes in general economic conditions indicates direct vulnerability. Affects pricing power and occupancy. Trend stable but macro factor = strong weighting.

risks.title: REIT distribution obligations and cash restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed in Item 5 (REIT status). Legal obligation to distribute 90% of annual taxable REIT income. Language must annually distribute indicates strict regulatory constraint. Additional restrictions in debt contracts. Trend stable but impacts financial flexibility.

risks.title: Reilly family shareholder control concentration
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in Item 5. Reilly family controls non-traded Class B shares via RFLLC. Kevin P. Reilly Jr. (Board Chair) and Sean E. Reilly (CEO) are managers. Governance and conflict-of-interest risk. Trend stable but concentrated control structure.

risks.title: Acquisition financing and rising indebtedness
risks.score_rationale: Risk in Item 7 (MD&A). 2025 acquisitions: 191.1 million USD in cash plus 147.6 million USD in partnership units (Verde Outdoor). Capital expenditures 2025: 180.8 million USD (vs 125.3 in 2024, +44%). Financing via debt and securities. Trend up (rising acquisitions and capex).

risks.title: Ordinary litigation and administrative proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in Item 3. Ordinary litigation (advertising contracts, leases, employment, construction) and administrative proceedings (permits, fees, citations). Language not likely to have a material adverse effect mitigates severity. Trend stable, managed risk.

ai_positioning.summary: The company LAMR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
